name: Fu Rong Ren: Tang Jianzhong Shisan-nian
source:
A text adventure game of the mid Tang Dynasty, where players can experience the story of a lonely city in the Western Regions during the Tang Tibetan War in the 13th year of Jianzhong by the 'bound barbarians'. Witness the growth and helplessness of characters and the rise and fall of the era. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353620]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一款中唐文字冒险游戏，玩家可以体验建中十三年唐藏战争期间，“缚夷”在西域孤城的故事。见证人物的成长与无奈，时代的兴衰。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3353620]Steam[/url]]
